history.summary: Large 1819 sqft 4BR in D05 West Coast at $1748 PSF — 8% below the $1900 resale median — on a near-perpetual 999yr lease, with a solid 5.76% URA resale CAGR (41 txns). One-North/TEL proximity supports the area, but the low PSF is partly the function of an oversized unit and the $3.18M quantum thins the buyer pool.
history.rating_rationale: Frontier entry (Elo 1718, on_frontier) with genuine value: $1748 PSF vs $1900 median (41 resale txns) on 999yr tenure that behaves like freehold. 5.76% resale CAGR is RCR-baseline-grade and credible. Build-quality reviews are mixed (rusting gates, average finishes), and at $3.18M the 4BR exits to a narrower pool — but the discount, near-freehold tenure and One-North/Clementi location make this a solid investment hold.

Low PSF partly reflects an oversized 1819 sqft unit, not pure underpricing
catalysts: One-North tech-hub and TEL/Clementi connectivity demand
999yr tenure preserves value vs ageing 99yr peers

history.summary: 1,819 sqft 4BR at $1,748 psf is at-market against same-size comps, not the 8% bargain the pooled median implied: the last ~1,819 sqft print was Feb 2024 at $1,598 psf ($2.908M), and escalating it at OCR-typical ~3.7%/yr puts fair value around $1,700-1,735 psf. The $1,900 pooled median that drove the prior Buy was set by a 947 sqft unit; large units structurally trade lower. D5/OCR region is a genuine positive, but a $3.18M 4BR quantum thins the exit pool and newer 99yr stock nearby (Parc Riviera ~$1,730, Twin Vew ~$1,650-1,935, Clavon ~$2,200) competes at exit.
history.rating_rationale: Re-judged under v3.4-v3.6 priors. (1) Same-size comp check (verified via propertyforsale.com.sg transaction table): Feb 2024, 1,819 sqft, floor 11-15, $2.908M / $1,598 psf — asking $1,748 is ~9% above that print, i.e. roughly fair after 2yrs of OCR appreciation, not cheap. Nearest large-unit prints: 1,496 sqft Nov 2025 @ $1,829; 1,388-1,399 sqft May 2025 @ $1,843-1,858 — an 1,819 sqft unit sits below these on the size curve. The prior eval cheapness was a pooled-median artifact (the $1,900 was a 947 sqft Feb 2026 high print). (2) Priors strip the old thesis: 5.76% trailing CAGR has ~0 forward power; 999yr tenure is a level premium already in the price, not a forward edge. (3) What survives: D5 = OCR (best realized forward region, +3.7%/yr) — but that is the region effect, not unit-specific edge. (4) CRL West Coast station confirmed for 2032 (construction underway since 2024-2025) but lands at/after a 5-7yr exit and infra-future scored ~0 marginal in backtest. (5) $3.18M 4BR quantum in an OCR district materially thins the resale pool. No genuine same-size discount + thin exit + de-emphasized old edges = Neutral; near-ties are Neutral under <10% explainable forward variance.
red_flags: Asking ~9% above the last same-size (1,819 sqft, Feb 2024) print — at-market/slightly rich once size-adjusted, the prior 8%-below-median claim was a pooled-median artifact
$3.18M quantum thins the 4BR OCR exit pool
Newer 99yr competition at exit: Parc Riviera ~$1,730 psf, Twin Vew ~$1,650-1,935, Clavon ~$2,200
No MRT in walking distance until CRL West Coast (~2032, at/past the hold window)
catalysts: CRL Phase 2 West Coast station (target 2032; construction started, Clementi groundbreaking Jul 2025) — late but real connectivity fix
D5/OCR regional tailwind (best realized forward region in backtest)
One-north / Jurong Lake District employment catchment
999yr tenure preserves relative value vs ageing 99yr peers (level support, not a return edge)
history.source: re-eval under v3.4.1+ priors (2026-06-11 loop iter 6; supersedes 2026-06-08 pre-prior-fix Buy)
